|game_text=If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Give_Yourself_To_The_Dark_Side.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-giveyourselftothedarkside-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012, slip 00; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) drops “from here” in the last sentence and writes “Son of Vader” (three times) and “Rebel Starships”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1281_18">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel Starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son of Vader as if from hand.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
